label: ui-top-bar
problem: P2 — top resource bar built each readout with a hand-tuned magic anchoredX chain (-16/-164/-188/-336/-360/-508/-532) and each icon at (anchoredX - kLabelWidth - kIconGap) where kLabelWidth=96 was a GUESSED pixel width of the Korean string. A 2-3 digit value widened the real text past 96px so the icon stopped hugging its number and the divider drifted into the neighbouring icon — the 'icon next to the wrong number' symptom the file's own comment admitted to and never fixed. Four readouts also had no shared cell, so spacing read random.
fix: Replaced the magic-offset chain with a RIGHT-anchored HorizontalLayoutGroup of N IDENTICAL [divider][icon][value] chips, order food->meal->wood->stone, equal width 156 (>=150 per spec), equal gap 8, thin Divider on each chip's leading edge, icon 36px left-anchored, value left-aligned filling the rest of the same fixed-width cell. Layout group computes every position, so a value growing a digit can never desync the icon or shove a divider into a neighbour. No per-resource anchoredX exists anymore.

layout.anchor: top full-width HeaderBg bordered panel, height 60 (unchanged)
layout.right: ResourceRow: HorizontalLayoutGroup anchored (1,0)-(1,1) pivot (1,0.5), rightInset 16, childAlignment MiddleRight, spacing 8
layout.chip: ResChip_<key>: fixed width 156 (LayoutElement preferred+min), inner HorizontalLayoutGroup MiddleLeft spacing 6 -> [ResSep_<key> 2px Divider][ResIcon_<key> 36px][<Name>Text flexibleWidth]

preserved.wiring: ResourceCounterUI SerializedObject refs (woodText/foodText/mealsText/stoneText) bind by component reference and still receive the Text objects returned by MakeResChip — unchanged.
preserved.panel: MakeBorderedPanel HeaderBg frame kept; ClockUI + TimeUI untouched
preserved.icon_load: Assets/Sprites/icon_<key>.png via AssetDatabase, missing-art warns + alpha 0 (kept)

removed: MakeResSeparator helper (free-floating divider at magic X)
bug_firewall: No baked-in lesson re-introduced. No audio loop, no GetInstanceID, no collision handler, no singleton OnEnable subscribe, no justSpawned default, no background timer/coroutine — this is pure static Editor scene-gen geometry.
